reason: The baseline read owner captures a private subprocess primitive before the preload denies general subprocess access; it only runs fixed git merge-base, ls-tree, and show object reads with validated refs, commits and exact paths, lazy fetching disabled, all protocols denied and terminal prompts disabled. No caller-supplied command or network transport is exposed.
The shared fetch implementation is imported by the model snapshot owner; check mode does not call it and the preload denies its runtime transport.
The snapshot module owns scheduled refresh transport; check mode reads committed inputs and the preload denies runtime transport.
